summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces in rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ does a prefix test (ref.startswith(self)), and ClosedNamespace.__contains__ checks node-type-aware equality against stored term URIs (inherited by _RDFNamespace). Also changed the ClosedNamespace IPython completion hook to dir(str(self.uri)). Added tests to test/test_namespace.py covering prefix positive/negative/self cases, SH, RDFS and RDF closed membership, and non-URIRef and container-property negatives. Tests were not run and no code was executed, per instructions; all verification is by reading. No commits made.
